MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The digital caliper would help me measure screw diameters and washer sizes, making it useful alongside my recent fastener purchases.",
    "Duct tape fits my occasional repair needs, although I would skip an eighteen-roll pack without a specific project."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Heat shrink tubing, cutting wheels and a temperature gun serve tasks I have not shown a current need for; buying fasteners does not mean I am wiring, cutting or checking temperatures.",
    "Filament requires a printing need I have not expressed, while epoxy and glue address bonding tasks that my recent hooks and screws do not establish.",
    "Large packs of tape or glue give me more supplies than I currently need, so general usefulness is not enough for me to choose them."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My hardware purchases seem to have been taken as interest in workshop supplies broadly, even when those supplies do not help with fastening or hanging.",
    "Buying assortments of screws and washers seems to have been taken as interest in bulk supplies generally, but those assortments offer useful sizes rather than many copies of the same consumable."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent purchases cluster around fasteners and magnetic hooks, so matching, measuring and using those items matters more to me than unrelated repair equipment.",
    "I rarely interact unless something meets a clear need; a plausible use someday is not enough to make me choose it now."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in hardware but stretched it into unrelated workshop tasks instead of focusing on my current fastening and hanging needs."
}
